# Add NestedPvm: SPI-backed inner PVM runner for refine

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

## Summary

- New `NestedPvm` class in refine context that decodes an SPI blob, sets up the inner PVM via `machine`/`pages`/`poke` host calls, and exposes a numeric-return invoke loop (`ExitReason`, `getExitArg`, register R/W, `remainingGas`/`setGas`, `expunge`).
- Available as `RefineContext.nestedPvmFromSpi(blob, args, gas)` for trusted input and `nestedPvmFromSpiChecked(blob, args, gas)` returning `ResultN<NestedPvm, SpiError>` for untrusted blobs (preimages, peer data).
- `examples/library/` migrated to run SPI-encoded preimages through `NestedPvm`. Demo input no longer carries an `entrypoint`; malformed SPI preimages surface as `LibraryError.MalformedPreimage = -107`.
- New smoke-test example `examples/nested-pvm-spi/` embeds the real 648-byte `as-add.jam` blob from @fluffylabs/pvm-debugger, strips the Standard-Program metadata prefix, and drives `NestedPvm` against the live fixture.

## Supporting changes

- `Decoder.u24()` little-endian helper (used by the SPI header decoder).
- `Decoder.fromBytesBlob(blob)` overload — cleaner than `fromBlob(blob.raw)`; migrated all SDK + example call sites.
- Refine `pages()`/`poke()` mocks now log each call; `TestMachine.pagesLogField/pokeLogField/pokeLogData` expose the logs so tests can assert the exact setup sequence.
- `docs/src/sdk-api/refine.md` documents `NestedPvm` + the updated library calling convention.

## Contract change (library example)

Library preimages are now SPI blobs rather than raw PVM code. The payload lives in the read-only SPI args region (`0xFEFF_0000`) instead of a caller-allocated RW page. Existing library blobs that only read their input continue to work; anything that mutated the args region needs updating. Discussed and approved in-thread.

## Test plan

- [x] `npm test` — all suites green (SDK 215/215, library 34/34, nested-pvm-spi 2/2, all others unchanged).
- [x] `npm run build` — all examples compile to WASM + PVM.
- [x] `npm run qa` — clean (1 info, 0 errors).
- [ ] Review the NestedPvm API surface — naming (`fromSpi` vs `fromSpiChecked`, `getExitArg`, `setGas`).
- [ ] Review the library contract change — confirm you're OK with preimages switching to SPI format.
- [ ] Confirm `examples/nested-pvm-spi/` is the right shape for future SPI smoke tests.

## Walkthrough

This PR adds a SPI-backed inner-PVM: new `NestedPvm` plus SPI layout constants and `SpiError`; two factories (`fromSpi`/`fromSpiChecked`) decode/validate SPI blobs, allocate/map pages (RO/RW/heap/stack/args), initialize registers/gas, and proxy invoke/register/gas/peek/poke/expunge operations. It adds `RefineContext.nestedPvmFromSpi` and `nestedPvmFromSpiChecked`, introduces `Decoder.fromBytesBlob` and `Decoder.u24` and `Encoder.u24`, updates examples/tests to use SPI-backed nested execution, and extends test mocks with pages/poke logging and query helpers.

## Possibly related PRs

- tomusdrw/as-lan PR 96 — Introduces the Machine/InvokeIo lifecycle wrapper that NestedPvm composes to create and drive inner PVM instances.  
- tomusdrw/as-lan PR 102 — Implements the earlier Machine-based inner-PVM calling convention in examples/library/refine that this PR replaces with the SPI-backed NestedPvm flow.  
- tomusdrw/as-lan PR 60 — Adds/refines the refine machines/ecalli mocks and host-call bindings that this PR extends with pages/poke logging and query helpers.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Proposed refactor</summary>

```diff
-function buildMinimalSpi(codeLen: u32): Uint8Array {
+function buildMinimalSpi(codeLen: u32): BytesBlob {

 }
```

</details>

As per coding guidelines, "Use `BytesBlob` by default instead of raw `Uint8Array` ... Raw `Uint8Array` is only acceptable in low-level code."

<!-- suggestion_start -->

<details>
<summary>📝 Committable suggestion</summary>

> ‼️ **IMPORTANT**
> Carefully review the code before committing. Ensure that it accurately replaces the highlighted code, contains no missing lines, and has no issues with indentation. Thoroughly test & benchmark the code to ensure it meets the requirements.

```suggestion
function buildMinimalSpi(codeLen: u32): BytesBlob {
  const enc = Encoder.create();
  // u24 roLength = 0
  enc.u8(0);
  enc.u8(0);
  enc.u8(0);
  // u24 rwLength = 0
  enc.u8(0);
  enc.u8(0);
  enc.u8(0);
  // u16 heapPages = 0
  enc.u16(0);
  // u24 stackSize = 0
  enc.u8(0);
  enc.u8(0);
  enc.u8(0);
  // u32 codeLength
  enc.u32(codeLen);
  for (let i: u32 = 0; i < codeLen; i++) enc.u8(0);
  return BytesBlob.wrap(enc.finishRaw());
}
```

</details>

<!-- suggestion_end -->

**Return the inner output bytes, not the packed `r7` descriptor.**

On `Halt`, `r7` holds a `(ptr, len)` pair into guest memory per the published calling convention. Serializing that register directly returns the address/length tuple instead of the inner program's actual output bytes, teaching the wrong contract and causing misbehavior under a real host.

Unpack `r7` using `vm.peek()` to read the actual output from guest memory, matching the reference implementation in `examples/library/assembly/refine.ts` (lines 103–127).

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
   const reason = vm.invoke();
   if (reason === ExitReason.Halt) {
-    const r7 = vm.getRegister(7);
-    logger.info(`refine: halted, r7=${r7}`);
-    vm.expunge();
-    const out = new Uint8Array(32);
-    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) out[i] = u8((r7 >> u64(i * 8)) & 0xff);
-    return ctx.respond(0, out);
+    const r7 = vm.getRegister(7);
+    logger.info(`refine: halted, r7=${r7}`);
+    const outPtr = u32(r7 & 0xffff_ffff);
+    const outLen = u32(r7 >> 32);
+    const out = BytesBlob.zero(outLen);
+    if (outLen > 0) {
+      const peekR = vm.peek(outPtr, out);
+      if (peekR.isError) {
+        vm.expunge();
+        return ctx.respond(-1);
+      }
+    }
+    vm.expunge();
+    return ctx.respond(0, out.raw);
   }
```
